description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called CameraPreviewActivity, which manages camera access, displays a camera preview, and handles camera availability issues.

classes.name: CameraPreviewActivity
classes.description: An Activity that displays the camera's preview, manages camera resource acquisition and release, and handles camera availability scenarios.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, opens the camera, and sets up the camera preview or a fallback UI if the camera is unavailable.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the camera resource when the activity is paused.

methods.name: getCameraInstance
methods.description: Attempts to safely open and return a Camera instance for a given camera ID.

methods.name: releaseCamera
methods.description: Releases the camera resource if it has been acquired.
